name: Granado Traditional Soap
about: A traditional soap from Granado, a pharmacy brand that started in Rio de Janeiro. Its classic scented lines are a well-known part of the city's history.
tip: Look for the traditional fragrance line, since Granado also sells many newer products.

name: Brazilian Cachaça
where: Cachaçaria Mangue Seco or a liquor specialty shop
about: Cachaça is a Brazilian spirit distilled from sugarcane. Rio de Janeiro state produces its own versions, which makes this a fitting local souvenir.
tip: Check that the label says it is from Rio de Janeiro state and note whether it is aged.
